summary.tagline: Los Barruecos is a natural monument (Spanish: monumento natural) in Malpartida de Cáceres, Extremadura, Spain.

days.title: Geology and Prehistoric Artifacts
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: la Seta
stops.detail: The large masses of granite have progressively degraded over millions of years to give rise to globular monolithic forms known as bolos, true sculptures molded by the hand of nature, which have received names such as la Seta or las Peñas del Tesoro.

stops.name: Peñas del Tesoro
stops.detail: An important prehistoric site is located in the Peñas del Tesoro that covers several of the stages of the region's Prehistory.

stops.name: Barrueco de Abajo
stops.detail: Among them is the one known as the Barrueco de Abajo, on whose shore the old Wool Wash house is located, which constitutes the current Vostell Malpartida Museum.

stops.name: El Ratero
stops.detail: El Ratero is a building constructed in the 18th century to house the wool industry of the area.
